name: AeroOne
description: A Gütersloh school team offering drone photography for property and construction firms.
review_question: Have customers ordered again, and can another operator deliver at the same quality and margin?

signals.text: Radio Gütersloh reported first customers for the student team's drone service.
The team won the national IW JUNIOR student-company competition.
The team reports five completed projects in spring 2026, including work for Kaup and Concept GT. Revenue and repeat orders require verification.

name: Heuwind Lagertechnik
description: A Bruchsal student designed a recycled-plastic support for storing hay bales.
review_question: Has a farm compared storage losses with ordinary pallets through a complete season?

signals.text: The school reported that the project won the March 24–25 Berlin pitch event and qualified for the national final.
Start-up BW reported the national JUGEND GRÜNDET win.

name: Moore UB
description: A Trondheim upper-secondary team developed a tracking strip for maritime rope.
review_question: Has a rope maker integrated the strip into production and tested legibility after wear at sea?

signals.text: Norway's organizer reported two awards at the Gen-E event held July 7–9 in Riga and described the strip integrated into the rope core.
Gen-E describes the team's digital rope-identification approach.

name: LIPIGO
description: A Košice grammar-school team developed washable children's glue made from edible ingredients.
review_question: Has the team secured a retail trial, repeat order or distribution agreement?

signals.text: Gen-E announced the Slovak national student-company win.
JA Europe lists LIPIGO first in its upper-secondary Company of the Year category.
The school reported selection among nine finalists for Startup Awards Slovakia.
The school announced an upcoming final in Bratislava. Its outcome requires a separate source.

name: GlioScope
description: A Kerry secondary-school student built an MRI-based research tool for profiling brain tumours.
review_question: Has an independent clinical group evaluated the tool on an external dataset?

signals.text: The Irish exhibition published its student-project award and described the research tool.
RTÉ reported a core prize at the European Union Contest for Young Scientists. Clinical deployment remains unverified.
